title: Revolución y reforma
goal: Read about two paths of twentieth-century change -- Bolivia's 1952 National Revolution and Costa Rica's 1948 civil war that led to abolishing its army.

items: Explain what the MNR did in Bolivia in April 1952.
Name three reforms the new Bolivian government decreed.
Explain what José Figueres Ferrer's junta did in Costa Rica.
State what Costa Rica's 1949 Constitution abolished.
Use mientras que to contrast two paths of change.

I can name three reforms the new Bolivian government decreed.
I can explain what José Figueres Ferrer's junta did in Costa Rica.
